title.rendered: What is AI mode in LG AC to improve comfort?

content.rendered:
With so many advancements in the technology, there are so many things that are being introduced in the market like refrigerators, smartphones, washing machines or air conditions. As all the brands are offering so many new features and innovative electronic goods, it is getting really easy for these brands to attract a lot of people. There are so many brands that you see in the market when it comes to latest Air Conditioner, with the best features and the best deals as well.

What is AI Mode in LG AC?

AI mode in LG AC – It means an Artificial Intelligence mode which is added in LG air conditionors. Go on the mode change button and find the artificial intelligence mode on the AC remote screen on display. One of the top brands that are in the market today is LG. You will be able to find the top and best air conditioners from LG. There are so many designs and models available from this brand. You will be able to choose from a wide range of collection and that is the best part of this brand LG. So, are you planning to buy an air conditioner? Then, before you look at the artificial intelligence controlled air conditioner from LG, let us look at a few basic things that you should know before you buy any air conditioner. You should be very careful when you are choosing an air conditioner, whether it is for your home or for your office. If you are buying an air conditioner for the first time, then here are a few things that you need to consider.

Specifications To Look For When Buying An Air Conditioner:

The technology has completely changed and you are able to see some interesting features in every electronic device these days. It is the same with air conditioners as well; they have changed a lot these days. They are in fact able to perform more than a typical air conditioner. They don’t just cool the air but does much more things. But do not get tempted with some features which are shown in an air conditioner, but are not at all useful for you. So, here is a list of some important features that an air conditioner should have when you are buying one.

Check Out The Chassis Type:

You will have to check out the chassis type very well. That plays a very important role when you are installing it and when you will have to get it repaired in case of any problem with the air conditioners. Some air conditioners will have heavy chassis and some will have very light one. Some air conditioners will also have detachable chassis as well. So, it is always good to go for light weight one, so that you will be able to get it installed with ease and the maintenance can also be done with ease. When you are going for window air conditioners, then slide out chassis is the best choice that you can make because you will be able to get the ac repair in Vadodara works done from the outside which can be pretty easy for the mechanic as well.

BTU Output

This parameter or feature is basically the cooling capacity of the air conditioner. When you are selecting the air conditioner, you should always make sure that you know the BTU factors as that plays a very important role in the performance of the air conditioner in the room. When you are selecting too high BTU output unit, then that is not going to do its job in the right way that means it does not dehumidify in the right way. At the same time, when you are selecting an under power one also; you will not have to see that it is performing well. So, it is always important that you select the right one.

Star Rating For Energy Saving

You will be able to find the air conditioners with star ratings and that is for saving some energy. Your air conditioner should be saving at least ten percent more power than the government standards. Only then the air conditioner will be qualified for energy saving star ratings. The more the number of stars, then more energy you will be able to save with that air conditioner. So, you need to be really smart while selecting one. You can go for either three-star rating air conditioner or you can also go for five-star rating air conditioner as well.

Warranty of The Air Conditioner

This is one of the must-have features that you must check without missing it. There is a very simple logic behind it. When the manufacturer is sure about their products, then they will surely stand for them. But if they are not ready to stand for it, then why you should even opt for them. The minimum warranty that you should look for is one year for the complete unit, including the labor charges as well.

Adjustable Louvers

The louvers are very helpful in adjusting the air flow in the direction that you want. You will be able to distribute the air in all the directions as per your choice and that is very important to consider. You may not have too many options with the window air conditioners, but with split air conditioners you will be able to adjust them in different directions for sure.

Adjustable Fan Controls

When you are choosing an air conditioner, you should also have to concentrate on the fan speed. You should be able to adjust the fan speed according to your choice and it should be having at least three different kinds of speed adjustments.

Digital Display

Initially, only the split air conditioners had that kind of features, but now the window air conditioners are also having this kind of feature. It is going to help you in adjusting the required temperature in the right way and that is very important. You will have the remote control and you will be able to operate it from any place as well.

Timer Facility

You should also be able to set the timer of the air conditioner. This will help you in operating the air conditioner when you are not at home and it can get the room cool by the time you reach home. At the same time, when you are sleeping, you will be able to set the timer to switch off the air conditioner after a certain period of time. That can save you some money over the electricity bill.

Air Purifiers And Filters

You should be having the best purifiers and filters for your air conditioners. You don’t have to always look for some easy to remove kind of filters as you are not going to remove them and clean them. You have the required technician for doing that job. All you will have to make sure is you are choosing an air conditioner with cleaner and best filter which are easy to clean, but not something that is easy to replace.

Dehumidifier Facility

You will be able to find some kind of air conditioners which are going to just act as the de-humidifiers. During certain seasons, you need not have to keep your house cool for a very long time and this kind of feature or facility is going to be useful at this point of time. These are some of the very important features that you will surely have to check. That means you cannot just neglect any of the features as you are investing on the air conditioner and you will need that to work for a long time. So, make sure that you do a good research before you actually buy one.

Air Conditioner Sizing

Did you anytime here about this air conditioner sizing concept? If you have ever gone for shopping an air conditioner, then you might have heard this word. This is also one of the important things that you should know when you are buying an air conditioner, be it an LG air conditioner or any other. This factor calculation can help you in making the best use of the air conditioner that you buy. In fact, you are going for a simple window air conditioner or an artificial intelligence fitted air conditioner, from LG, this information can be really useful for you. Use Of Air Conditioners The basic function of an air conditioner is either to remove the heat present in the room or for adding some heat to the temperature of the room. The sizing factor is important for knowing the capacity to heat removal or heat addition in the room where the air conditioner is fitted. Units Used For Determining Sizing The basic units that are used for determining the sizing factor of the air conditioner are BTU which means British Thermal Units, Watts, and ton as well. It can be easy for you to understand the sizing concept while buying an air conditioner when you are familiar with these units.
  • 1 ton is equal to 12000 BTU per hour.
  • 12000 BTU per hour is equal to 3516 Watts (or you can say it is 3.516 kW).

Fundamentals of Air Conditioner Sizing

The basic concept of this sizing is based on how the heat is removed and how it is added. It is a common thing that when the temperature outside is hot, then you need to remove the heat from the room or the building. When the temperature outside is cool, then you need to add heat to the building or room. That means, in simple words, you should be able to balance the temperature outside and inside in order to get the temperature that you desire.

What Factors Are Going To Decide The Amount Of Heat To Be Added Or Removed?

There are some simple things or factors to decide this:

Temperature Difference

The difference in the temperature that needs in your room and the temperature outside the room is one of the basic factors. When you are having hot summer, then you need to remove a lot of heat from the room to make it cool and to maintain it. At the same time, on a mild day, when it is not too hot or too cold, you need not have to do much.

The Material Used In The Room

The material that is used for the construction of the room is going to make the difference. If you are having two rooms of the same size, but the material used is different like one is made of glass, whereas the other is made of brick, then that is definitely going to make a difference. The one made of glass will need more energy to remove heat and to make it cool and maintain it cool for a longer time.

The Wall Surface

When the surface area is more, then it will release more heat and at the same time gain heat as well. So, this is one of the factors determining the sizing.

Infiltration

If there are any cracks in the wall, any gaps in the doors, any holes in the doors, any ventilation facility available in the room, which would allow air to pass in and out of the room, then it can be tough for the air conditioner to maintain the desired temperature and that also affects the sizing.

Kind Of Activity In The Room

If the place where the air conditioner is placed is used for hot baths, cooking or gymnasium, then there will be more heat generated continuously and you will have to keep the temperature really low to maintain the desired temperature. If you are using it for sleeping or reading, the temperature will remain the same all the time.

The Square Meter Method

When you are choosing an air conditioner, then you can see that the sales person will ask you the size of your room. Basically, a blind calculation is 1 ton for five hundred square feet of the floor area. This is a simple and blind calculation, which can be ideal in most of the cases. But this calculation will again depend on all the above factors specified. So, you will have to make sure that you are considering all the factors and then buying the right air conditioner, which can keep the room cool for a longer time and at the same time it does not take too much time for cooling. Something like dual panel air conditioner can be a good choice because it has two panels for cooling nearby and far areas of the room. At the same time, you can save energy by switching off one panel when not required.

Artificial Intelligence Fitted Air Conditioners From LG:

LG AI Based Air Conditioner is one of the new innovations of this brand. You will be able to select from nineteen different models of air conditioners which are fitted with the artificial Intelligence feature. Among so many different models from AI Ready Air Conditioner, Whisen Dual Air conditioner is a popular one.

Whisen Dual Air Conditioner

This air conditioner is having two different cold air outlets and they are controlled individually. With this air conditioner, you will be able to control the direction of the air flow along with the strength of the air. This is definitely one of the best models from LG because it is very easy to satisfy people with just one air conditioner. You will be able to enjoy good cooling speed in just no time and along with that you will also be able to save energy as well. That means you will be able to enjoy the temperature that you need without having to spend too high. Dual Panel – Is An Advantage Generally, the problem that you may face with the normal air conditioners is you will not be able to receive air to all parts of the room. But when you are using this air conditioner, then you will be able to adjust the panels of it according to your choice. You can adjust one panel of the air conditioner towards the people sitting close to the air conditioner and the other panel can be adjusted according to the people sitting in the other corner or at a far distance. Consumers Very Little Energy – Saves Power There are so many interesting features in this air conditioner that many consumers will be worried about the power consumption. That is just a myth only. You will, in fact, be able to save more power using this LG air conditioner. You will be able to save 40 percent energy. When you are using just one panel, then you will be able to save more 35 percent compared to two panels operating. When you compare with the other models of the air conditioners whether, from LG brand or other brands, the cooling time is 20 percent less than them. Apps For Checking The Conditioner Of The LG Air Conditioner You have apps like KaKao Talk, LINE and LG Whisen App using which you will be able to control the air conditioner. You will be able to control and manage it even if you are outside. You will be able to check the overall condition of the air conditioner and then use it accordingly. With the help of these apps, you will also be able to check the replacement periods and bills as well. Smog Deodorization Filter This particular Whisen dual air conditioner is having the best filters like 3MTM Ultra fine particle filter which is going to help in removing dust from the air. It is going to filter even the 0.02 pm size dust particles as well. The smog deodorization filter helps in maintaining the odor of the room as well. Energy Frontier Certification All the 19 models of air conditioners that are having artificial intelligence feature are energy frontier certified. That means you will be able to save 150 percent more energy and hence you will be able to save more money as well. This is one the best air conditioners released by LG. Maintenance Of LG Air Conditioner One of the best innovations done by the human beings is air conditioners and LG is working towards providing the best air conditioners to the esteemed customers. You have the best and beautiful models of air conditioners from LG, which are just perfect for the summers in India, in fact from all parts of the world. You will be able to enjoy a cool and pleasant environment when you have the LG air conditioner installed in your house or your workplace. One important thing to remember about the air conditioners is they are not cheap, and LG is promising its customers to offer the air conditioners at the best possible price. Whatever is the price, you will have to make sure that you are maintaining the air conditioner in the right way. This is going to help in keeping the air conditioner in a good condition for a longer time. Remember, there is no one who is going to buy a new air conditioner every year. You will have to make sure that you are maintaining it in the right way. Keep A Performance Check As long as the air conditioner is giving you cool air, you will not concentrate on the air conditioner maintenance and this is something done by everyone. But even if it is giving cool air, the air conditioner is losing the efficiency by 5 percent every year. Usually, if you are not maintaining well, then they will stop working soon. The normal life span of an air conditioner is for 15 years and sometimes, it can run for a longer time if you are really maintaining well. You will have to check for the unusual sounds coming from the air conditioner, the water leakage or the drain tubes as well. Check The Filters You will have to make sure that the filters are always kept. That is when you will be able to get cool and hygienic air in the room. If the filters are not clean and clear, then the air that is being released is not at all perfect and healthy. You should make sure that the air conditioner filters are being cleaned from time to time. If you are having any interest in doing it yourself, then you can ask the technician next time and learn it. It is a very simple and easy process. Do Not Do It Yourself You can try to handle a few minor things can filter cleaning and other minor things yourself. But when you sense that there is something major, then do not even try to open it or use it at any cost. That may worsen the condition of the problem inside. As long as you are having a warranty and free servicing facility available for your air conditioner, you can make use of that facility. That is going to help you in getting the things done for no cost. Do not mishandle the air conditioner, if you are not sure of anything, then you can refer the user manual or get in touch with the experts using the customer support. As long as you handle it with care, the life of the air conditioner is also going to increase. It all depends on how you are using and handling the air conditioners. LG air conditioners usually have a good life and when you handle them right, then you will be able to enjoy the best services from LG. Also View: 4 Signs that AC can’t make it through Summer
